entities.name: Necdet Özel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Necdet Özel is a Turkish general, who served as the 28th Chief of the General Staff of the Turkish Armed Forces. He also served as the commander of the Turkish Land Forces. Özel is only the second in this position not to have NATO experience.
